Chapter 6260: Backers

Chapter 6260: Backers

Ruyi Monarch's fate palaces blossomed beautifully and summoned a golden spring with a lotus flower.

This flower served as a throne with rotating petals as sharp as blades to lacerate those daring to approach. He tossed his scepter into the air and it grew massively, looking like a green mountain range.

"Ruyi Suppression!" He launched an attack against Bronze-blade using the scepter, causing spatial cracks along the way.

Others were amazed at its destructive potential. Meanwhile, the crown prince also released his boundless vitality through the fate palaces. It surged upward like a river as he raised his sword.

"Skyraiser Draconic Blade!" His vitality resembled burning flames capable of piercing the azure.

A dragon appeared and coiled around the blade, becoming one with it in the blink of an eye. Two auras ravaged the battlefield - a sword and a dragon affinity.

"Go!" The sword slashed in Coldblade's direction.

They wanted to finish the duo by destroying the incomplete dao fruit, preventing the breakthrough.

"Incredible." Many thought these two pseudo-emperors could destroy sects without a problem.

"Watch it!" Some shouted and worried about the duo.

After all, they were occupied with condensing their first dao fruit. Any interruption might result in death.

"Bronze Emperor Blade!" Bronze-blade's eyes flashed brightly and his imperial aura erupted. He became large enough to contend against the mountain range.

He swung his blade and could sweep the stars above, easily cutting through the ruyi scepter.

The latter shattered and Ruyi Monarch was sent flying while vomiting blood.

On the other side, a swift flash from Coldblade was too fast for anyone to see. "Clank!" She drew blood in the blink of an eye.

The four had similar battle potential not long ago. However, these two almost had the power of emperors now and the disparity became clear.

She didn't stop and wanted to kill him.

"Damn!" The crown prince utilized a dozen movement techniques, wanting to dodge the gleaming saber.

Alas, his agile and swift evasion still couldn't lose it. He looked back and saw the incoming blade. He closed his eyes in preparation for death.

At the same time, Bronze-blade also pursued the attacker. A bronze radiance descended like a waterfall.

"Die!" He intended to cut the monarch into two halves.

"This is it for me?!" Ruyi Monarch bellowed.

Coldblade and Bronze-blade showed no mercy, already possessing the style of emperors.

"Bam!" Just when everyone thought the attackers were finished, the fatal moves were blocked.

The one who saved Skyraiser Crown Prince was a beautiful woman. A frown or smile from her could charm the soul. Although she no longer possessed the spring of youth, others couldn't look away from her mature charm.

Alas, they felt a sharp pain in the chest instantly due to the imperial rays emanating from her eyes. She had no trouble blocking Coldblade's saber using a sword made of frost.

On the other side, a middle-aged man in a crimson robe posed with both hands behind his back, looking like a fire god. The fiery aura from him appeared unstoppable.

"Frost and Crimson Cauldron Emperor." Others recognized them.

"Their dao protectors were also brought here." An expert took a deep breath.

One came from Skyraiser Dynasty and the other Devil Cult. Frost had nine fruits, rumored to be an ice seed demon. Crimson Cauldron was a member of the fire tribe, possessing heightened fire mastery versus others.

"Congratulations, Fellow Daoists. Almost." Crimson Cauldron spoke, possessing eight dao fruits.

Bronze-blade and Coldblade had a serious expression since they were facing powerful veterans.

"They can't finish it now." The crowd took a deep breath.

"It's time to give up the area." Frost uttered coldly.

If they were to comply, they would have to stop the fruit manifestation process and fail to prove their dao.
